description: This file defines a custom implementation of a multiprocessing Pool class that uses shared memory queues (via SimpleQueue) for inter-process communication, along with a cleanup worker function to trigger garbage collection. It extends the standard multiprocessing pool to optimize transport of tensors across processes, likely for performance improvements in a PyTorch context.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: A subclass of multiprocessing.pool.Pool that uses custom SimpleQueue instances for shared memory communication of tensors.

methods.name: clean_worker(*args, **kwargs)
methods.description: A worker function that calls the original multiprocessing worker and then explicitly triggers garbage collection to ensure proper cleanup of resources.

methods.name: _setup_queues(self)
methods.description: Initializes the input and output queues using SimpleQueue, and sets up quick send/receive methods.

methods.name: _repopulate_pool(self)
methods.description: Replenishes the pool by starting additional worker processes up to the specified number, replacing exited workers.
